stem.text: A box, in the shape of a cube, falls from a ship into the sea. The box lands with its lower face level with the surface of the sea.

stem.alt: Cube resting on the top face of a block, labelled box on the surface of the sea and surface of sea.
Cube drawn inside a block, with the top face labelled surface of sea and a label box sinking.

stem.text: The box begins to sink, becomes totally submerged and then sinks deeper into the sea.
As the box sinks, its lower face is always parallel to the surface of the sea.
Which graph best represents the variation of the upthrust acting on the box with the depth of its lower face below the surface of the sea?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis upthrust and horizontal axis depth, both starting at 0, showing a straight line rising from the origin.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis upthrust and horizontal axis depth, both starting at 0, showing a horizontal straight line.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis upthrust and horizontal axis depth, both starting at 0, showing a straight line rising from the origin and then becoming horizontal.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis upthrust and horizontal axis depth, both starting at 0, showing a curve rising from the origin and then levelling off to a horizontal line.
